name: v1.0.0
body:
## What's Changed
* GOVUKAPP-1556 : OneLogin sign in fail error screen by @gclssvglx in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/263

* GOVUKAPP-1697 Create Modal in-app browser page by @TimGJD in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/291

* GOVUKAPP-1783 Notifications onboarding screen won't progress on Android 12 by @TimGJD in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/293
* GOVUKAPP-1586: Fix issue with screen not scrolling when text and display size are at max size by @gclssvglx in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/294
* GOVUKAPP-1560: Attestation by @davidc-gds in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/296

* GOVUKAPP-1877 Show alert dialog when turn off notifications clicked by @TimGJD in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/306
* GOVUKAPP-1866: Biometrics skipped flag by @davidc-gds in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/308
* GOVUKAPP-1912 Info and relationships - What is your postcode? by @TimGJD in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/310
* GOVUKAPP-1870 RealmProvider.open crash by @TimGJD in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/309
* GOVUKAPP-1914 Form element roles - Local by @TimGJD in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/314
* GOVUKAPP-1910 Unlabelled form controls - Search by @TimGJD in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/313
* GOVUKAPP-1867: Biometrics on settings by @davidc-gds in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/315
* Enable login in debug builds by @davidc-gds in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/316
* GOVUKAPP-1908 Focus order (Topics) by @TimGJD in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/317
* GOVUKAPP-1911 Unlabelled form controls - Settings by @TimGJD in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/312
* GOVUKAPP-1909 Unlabelled form controls - Home by @TimGJD in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/311
* GOVUKAPP-1915 Status changes - Search by @TimGJD in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/318
* GOVUKAPP-1950 : minor content fix on local success screen for a two-tier response by @gclssvglx in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/319
* GOVUKAPP-1948: Secure store fingerprint crash by @davidc-gds in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/320
* GOVUKAPP-1886 : Token expiry content update by @gclssvglx in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/322
* GOVUKAPP-1947 Cached cognito request by @TimGJD in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/321
* GOVUKAPP-1908 Fix focus requester crash by @TimGJD in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/323
* GOVUKAPP-1996 Set feature flags ready for release by @TimGJD in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/324
* Deeplink intent fix by @davidc-gds in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/325
* Blank token fix by @davidc-gds in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/326
* GOVUKAPP-1883: Cursor colour by @davidc-gds in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/327
* GOVUKAPP-1884: Open source licenses bug by @davidc-gds in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/328
* GOVUKAPP-1937 Public beta ready by @TimGJD in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/330
* GOVUKAPP-1869: Search user agent by @davidc-gds in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/331
* GOVUKAPP-2026 : Make biometrics content more generic by @gclssvglx in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/335
* Biometrics nav fix by @davidc-gds in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/336
* Update auth urls by @davidc-gds in https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/pull/338


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-mobile-android-app/compare/v0.1.0...v1.0.0
